<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>POST</http_method><name>collect</name><operation_script><![CDATA[/**
 * Scripted REST resource: POST /collect
 * Collects this instance's configuration and saves it (same as the Collect now
 * UI action on the instance CI). Used by the Current Instance Settings page.
 * Requires x_2160899_driftw_0.configuration_admin (checked here as well).
 */
(function process(request, response) {
    if (!gs.hasRole('x_2160899_driftw_0.configuration_admin')) {
        response.setStatus(403);
        response.setBody({ error: 'Requires role x_2160899_driftw_0.configuration_admin' });
        return;
    }
    try {
        var snapshot = new ConfigNowCollector({ incremental: true }).collect();
        var res = new ConfigNowWriter().persist(snapshot);
        response.setStatus(200);
        response.setBody({
            instance_name: snapshot.instance ? snapshot.instance.instance_name : '',
            collected_at: snapshot.collected_at,
            duration_ms: snapshot.duration_ms,
            totals: res.totals,
            run_id: res.run_id || '',
            changes_logged: res.changes_logged || 0,
            baseline: res.baseline || [],
            warnings: snapshot.warnings ? snapshot.warnings.length : 0
        });
    } catch (e) {
        response.setStatus(500);
        response.setBody({ error: String(e && e.message ? e.message : e) });
    }
})(request, response);
]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/x_2160899_driftw_0/configurationnow/collect</operation_uri><produces>application/json,application/xml,text/xml</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/collect</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>false</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description/><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-07 16:28:54</sys_created_on><sys_id>d4fdbbd783989f10f22797efeeaad3b2</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>collect</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Driftwood" source="x_2160899_driftw_0">23f0006a83d0d710f22797efeeaad3e1</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Driftwood">23f0006a83d0d710f22797efeeaad3e1</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_d4fdbbd783989f10f22797efeeaad3b2</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-07 16:55:13</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="ConfigurationNOW">9234cc628314d710f22797efeeaad34b</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>
